name: How do I choose the right contractor for an aging-in-place bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an aging-in-place bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, look for one with specific experience in aging-in-place design and remodeling. Verify their licensing and insurance, and check references from previous clients who have had similar work completed. A reputable contractor will conduct a thorough assessment of your needs, provide a detailed proposal, and communicate clearly throughout the project. Prioritize those familiar with local building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with specific aging-in-place experience, verify their license and insurance, check references, and ensure clear communication and local code familiarity.
